chapter: Looking back, big bands and sidemen
title: Joe Romano and Bill Perkins join overnight in California
summary: Romano and Bill Perkins joined at the same time in California, among many interesting players of the period.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: I know that during the upstate New York focus, did you have Joe Romano, too? Wasn't he --
Yeah. He had a certain amount of drive.
Joe first joined us in California. He was -- I don't know what he was doing out there. He was there, and we made some changes overnight and he was one of them and Bill Perkins was the other.
They came in the band at the same time.
There were a lot of interesting players in the band, during that period.
You sure have, yeah. I bet you can take every section and then start putting names down on that heading and then see --

See who you would come up with. That's really incredible. Yeah, I was interested in that because I knew I would prompt you to think about how the band gets its recruits and replacements and the adaptations of these new recruits.
